ei.title: Cycling as a Lifestyle and Social Status
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" (A)[craze / decline] has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with (B)[poverty / wealth] for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in (C)[impressing / discouraging] others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① craze — poverty — impressing: 원문 일치. '라이프스타일로서의 자전거 타기' 열풍(craze), 자전거가 가난(poverty)과 연관됐던 과거, 타인에게 감명을 주는(impressing) 활동 ←정답
❌ ② decline(쇠퇴): 열풍이 아닌 쇠퇴라면 이후 내용과 모순
❌ ③ wealth(부유함): 가난(poverty)이 아닌 부유함이라면 '갑자기 열망의 제품이 됐다'는 역전 논리가 성립 안 됨
❌ ④ discouraging(낙담시키다): impressing(감명)의 반의어 방향으로 부적절
det.tip: craze(열풍) ↔ decline(쇠퇴), poverty(빈곤) ↔ wealth(부유), impress(감명) ↔ discourage(낙담)

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club (A)[membership / opposition] in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic (B)[reinterpretation / preservation] of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become (C)[aspirational / obsolete] products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① membership — preservation — aspirational: (B) preservation(보존)은 재해석이 아닌 보존이므로 자전거의 상징적 의미 변화 맥락에 부적절
❌ ② opposition — reinterpretation — aspirational: (A) opposition(반대)은 클럽 가입/멤버십과 다른 의미
✅ ③ membership — reinterpretation — aspirational: 원문 일치. 클럽 멤버십(membership) 증가, 자전거의 상징적 재해석(reinterpretation), 열망의 제품(aspirational) ←정답
❌ ④ membership — reinterpretation — obsolete: (C) obsolete(구식의)는 aspirational(열망의)의 반의어로 부적절
det.tip: membership(멤버십) ↔ opposition(반대), reinterpretation(재해석) ↔ preservation(보존), aspirational(열망의) ↔ obsolete(구식의)

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its (A)[demonstrative / trivial] value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-(B)[laden / free] consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and (C)[conspicuous / discreet] consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) demonstrative=과시적인/입증하는, (B) laden=가득 찬/~이 배어 있는, (C) conspicuous=두드러진/과시적인
det.analysis:
✅ ① demonstrative — laden — conspicuous: 원문 일치. 과시적(demonstrative) 가치, 가치가 배어 있는(value-laden) 소비, 과시적(conspicuous) 소비 ←정답
❌ ② trivial — laden — conspicuous: (A) trivial(사소한)은 demonstrative(과시적인)의 반대 의미로 부적절
❌ ③ demonstrative — free — conspicuous: (B) value-free(가치 중립적)는 value-laden(가치로 가득 찬)의 반의어
❌ ④ demonstrative — laden — discreet: (C) discreet(신중한/조심스러운)은 conspicuous(두드러진)의 반의어
det.tip: demonstrative(과시적) ↔ trivial(사소한), value-laden(가치로 가득 찬) ↔ value-free(가치 중립적), conspicuous(과시적/두드러진) ↔ discreet(신중한)

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an ①<u>increase</u> in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been ②<u>accompanied</u> by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and ③<u>signaling</u> social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic ④<u>minor</u> of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① increase(증가): 원문 일치. 자전거 이용자 수 증가 맥락에 적절
✅ ② accompanied(수반된): 원문 일치. 상징적 재해석이 함께 나타났다는 맥락
✅ ③ signaling(신호 보내다): 원문 일치. 사회적 지위를 알리는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ minor(사소한): 원문은 marker(지표/표시). 자전거 타기가 부유층의 '상징적 지표'가 됐다는 맥락에서 'minor(사소한)'는 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: marker(지표/표시) = 어떤 사회적 신호를 나타내는 표지. minor(사소한)은 형용사로 품사도 다름

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active cyclists and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been ①<u>associated</u> with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity ②<u>construction</u> and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the ③<u>well-off</u>. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means ④<u>extended</u> to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① associated(연관된): 원문 일치. 자전거가 가난과 연관됐다는 맥락
✅ ② construction(형성/구성): 원문 일치. 정체성 형성에서의 역할
✅ ③ well-off(부유한): 원문 일치. 부유층의 상징적 지표
❌ ④ extended(확장된): 원문은 limited(한정된). '가치 기반 소비는 자전거에만 한정되지 않는다'는 맥락에서 extended는 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: limited to(~에 한정된) ↔ extended to(~로 확장된). by no means limited = 결코 ~에만 국한되지 않는다

questions.passage: The recent "cycling as a lifestyle" craze has expressed itself in an increase in the number of active ①<u>cyclists</u> and in growth of cycling club membership in several European, American, Australian and Asian urban areas. It has also been accompanied by a symbolic reinterpretation of the bicycle. After the bicycle had been associated with poverty for many years, expensive recreational bicycles or recreationally-inspired commuting bicycles have suddenly become aspirational products in urban environments. In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its demonstrative value, its role in identity construction and its ②<u>obscure</u> in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity ③<u>construction</u> and conspicuous consumption has become particularly ④<u>manifest</u> in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① cyclists(자전거 이용자): 원문 일치. 자전거 타기 열풍으로 이용자 수 증가
❌ ② obscure(불분명한): 원문은 effectiveness(효과). 타인에게 인상을 주는 '효과(effectiveness)'라는 맥락에서 obscure(불분명한)는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ construction(형성/구성): 원문 일치. 정체성 형성 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ manifest(뚜렷한/명백한): 원문 일치. 자전거 타기에서 이 연관성이 특히 뚜렷하게 나타난다는 맥락
det.tip: effectiveness(효과) ↔ obscure(모호한). 글에서 자전거의 '효과'가 타인에게 인상을 주는 것임

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② urban: 원문 일치. 유럽·미국·호주·아시아 도시(urban) 지역에서 자전거 열풍이 나타난다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ① rural(농촌의): 자전거 문화가 도시 현상으로 묘사되므로 부적절
❌ ③ coastal(해안의): 지역을 특정 지형으로 제한하는 것은 원문과 다름
❌ ④ industrial(산업의): 산업 지역이라는 맥락은 없음
det.tip: urban(도시의) ↔ rural(농촌의). 이 글에서 자전거 열풍은 도시 현상으로 반복 강조됨

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① aspirational: 원문 일치. 오랫동안 가난의 상징이었던 자전거가 갑자기 '열망의 대상(aspirational)'이 됐다는 역전 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② affordable(저렴한): 비싼(expensive) 자전거가 열망 제품이 됐다는 맥락과 반대
❌ ③ functional(기능적인): 과시적·상징적 소비라는 글의 논지와 맞지 않음
❌ ④ outdated(구식의): 새롭게 부상했다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: aspirational(열망의): 갖고 싶다는 욕망을 불러일으키는. 'aspirational product' = 명품·프리미엄 제품처럼 동경 대상이 되는 제품

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① consumption: 원문 일치. '가치가 배어 있는(value-laden) 소비(consumption) 행동'이 자전거에만 국한되지 않는다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② regulation(규제): 규제 행동이 자전거에만 한정되지 않는다는 맥락은 글 논지와 무관
❌ ③ competition(경쟁): 경쟁 행동 맥락은 이 글에서 언급 없음
❌ ④ investigation(조사): 조사 행동이라는 맥락은 글에서 벗어남
det.tip: consumption(소비) — conspicuous consumption(과시적 소비): Veblen이 제시한 개념. 지위를 드러내기 위한 소비

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 craze와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:

det.tip: craze = trend = fad(일시적 유행). craze는 특히 열광적 인기를 강조

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 associated와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ① contrasted(대조된): associated는 대조가 아닌 연관

det.tip: associated with = linked to = connected with(~와 연관된). be associated with = ~와 관련되다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 conspicuous와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ showy: conspicuous(과시적인/눈에 띄는)와 의미가 가장 가까운 단어 ←정답
❌ ① moderate(적당한/온건한): 과시적과 반대 방향
❌ ② hidden(숨겨진): conspicuous의 반의어
❌ ③ practical(실용적인): 과시 소비와 대조되는 개념
det.tip: conspicuous(과시적/두드러진): conspicuous consumption(과시적 소비) = 지위 과시를 위한 소비. ↔ inconspicuous(눈에 띄지 않는)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 poverty와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① affluence: poverty(빈곤)의 반의어. 풍요롭고 부유한 상태 ←정답
❌ ② shortage(부족): poverty와 유사 의미 방향
❌ ③ misery(불행/비참함): poverty와 관련은 있지만 반의어는 아님
❌ ④ simplicity(단순함): 빈곤과 다른 차원의 개념
det.tip: poverty(빈곤) ↔ affluence(풍요) = wealth(부) = prosperity(번영). 글에서 자전거가 poverty → aspirational product로 역전되는 것이 핵심

In present times, cycling has become an activity which is also performed for its <u>demonstrative</u> value, its role in identity construction and its effectiveness in impressing others and signaling social status. To a certain extent, cycling has turned into a symbolic marker of the well-off. Obviously, value-laden consumption behavior is by no means limited to cycling. However, the link with identity construction and conspicuous consumption has become particularly manifest in the case of cycling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 demonstrative와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ understated: demonstrative(과시적/드러내는)의 반의어. 절제되고 드러내지 않는다는 의미 ←정답
❌ ① expressive(표현적): demonstrative와 유사 의미
❌ ② symbolic(상징적): 본문에서 함께 쓰이는 유사 개념
❌ ④ obvious(명백한): demonstrative와 의미축이 겹침
det.tip: demonstrative(과시적/표현적) ↔ understated(절제된). restrained(자제하는)도 유사 반의어

questions.passage:
(A) The bicycle had been <u>associated</u> with poverty for many years before it became a status symbol among the well-off.

(B) The two companies decided to merge and become <u>associated</u> under a single brand name to strengthen their market position.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 associated의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) associated = 연관되다(be linked with), (B) associated = 협력하다/연합하다(join together)
det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 연관되다 — (B) 협력하다: (A)는 자전거가 가난과 '연관됐다'는 수동 의미, (B)는 두 회사가 하나의 브랜드 아래 '협력·연합한다'는 능동적 결합 의미 ←정답
❌ ① (A) 협력하다 — (B) 연관되다: (A)(B) 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (A) 대조되다 — (B) 협력하다: (A) associated는 대조가 아닌 연관
❌ ④ (A) 연관되다 — (B) 대조되다: (B) associated는 대조가 아닌 협력/연합
det.tip: associate: ① be associated with = ~와 연관되다(수동, 추상적 연결) ② associate with/under = 협력·연합하다(능동, 조직적 결합)

questions.stem:

the degree to which something achieves a desired result or produces a desired effect

det.analysis:
✅ ③ effectiveness: '원하는 결과 또는 효과를 달성하는 정도' = 효과(성) ←정답
❌ ① efficiency(효율): 낭비 없이 수행하는 능력 — 결과의 질보다 과정의 경제성 강조
❌ ② significance(중요성): 중요한 정도를 의미하며 결과 달성과 다름
❌ ④ sufficiency(충분함): 충분히 갖춰진 상태로 다른 의미
det.tip: effectiveness(효과성) vs. efficiency(효율성): effectiveness = 목표 달성 여부, efficiency = 자원 낭비 없이 수행하는 능력

det.analysis:
✅ ③ well-off: 원문 일치. 자전거가 '부유층(well-off)의 상징적 지표'가 됐다는 맥락. 가난의 상징에서 부유층의 상징으로 역전된 논지와 일치 ←정답
